_readme: Fill in every null under studio and payments. qa.js blocks all sending while any required field is null.

studio.postalAddress: Lilium Street, Barangay Dalig, Antipolo City, Rizal 1870, Philippines

payments.rules: Invoices are created by you in PayPal and sent from PayPal. Never ask for card numbers, bank logins or passwords in any message.
payments._paypalOwner: Name clients see on PayPal invoices. Mention it in the invoice message so a different name is not a surprise.

settings._phpPerUSD: Set the rate you actually receive from PayPal so the goal total is accurate.
settings._pricing: Each prospect gets a tier from its complexity (simple / standard / menu). Set prospect.quote to override. Never quote below minQuoteUSD (or the market equivalent) without asking the owner.
settings._deliverability: emailWarmup: [days since first email pitched, max emails per send day]. pitch.js spaces emails at least emailGapMinutes apart (sender time) and rolls overflow to the next send day. See playbook/deliverability.md.
settings._goal: goalUSDPerYear: the yearly revenue pace to reach by goalBy. learn.js tracks run-rate (care plans x 12 + last 90 days of build revenue x 4) against it.
settings._fxToUSD: Approximate rates used only to add up revenue in USD. Replace them with the rates PayPal actually gives you.
settings._dailyCap: Hard ceiling on all new first-touch messages in one send day (email + Messenger/SMS). The real email cap comes from the warm-up table and data/send-state.json (set by learn.js), never above emailCeiling.
settings._emailCeiling: Most cold emails per day from one Gmail inbox, however healthy the numbers look. Going past it needs a second sending domain and inbox, which costs money: ask the owner.

US.notes: Every email needs your physical postal address and a working opt-out. No cold SMS to US numbers (TCPA risk).
US._careTiers: basic: hosting, updates and small edits. growth: basic plus Google Business Profile upkeep (2 posts a month, hours and photos kept current), a review-request link and printable QR card, and a short monthly report. annualMonths: paying a year up front costs this many months. Pitches sent before 2026-11-15 quoted careQuote; honor that price for them.

CA.notes: Only emails the business publishes conspicuously, with no 'no solicitations' note, and the pitch must relate to their business.
